8868f7ca4dbb: Set Up MultiDatePick in Salesforce: Getting Started
d106769c7d2b: How to install and set up MultiDatePick for Salesforce
12513896dc58: Install the MultiDatePick package, assign a permission set, build a configuration in the Setup Wizard, then add the calendar to a Lightning page or a Screen Flow. No Apex required.
2e451f87c58b: Click Get It Now on the AppExchange listing and install for admins, all users or specific profiles. Then check Setup, Installed Packages.
1b87af94a637: Assign MultiDatePick - Setup to the admins who build configs and MultiDatePick - User to everyone who uses the calendars. MultiDatePick - All Access covers both.
e9f111f2f3a6: Build a config in the Setup Wizard
bbc3183fb23b: Open the MultiDatePick Setup Wizard, choose Walk me through it or Configure all properties, pick your object and fields from dropdowns, and save. Or import a ready-made config from the Config Library.
385e8dea592c: Add the calendar to a Lightning page
303d41c766ca: In Lightning App Builder, drag the MultiDatePick component onto a record page and set Config Name. On App, Home and Experience pages also set Static Parent Record Id.
b1299441dd4f: Or add it to a Screen Flow
407a4030c9fe: In Flow Builder, drag the MultiDatePick component onto a screen and set Config Name to your Setup Wizard config. Every checkbox setting comes from the config.
ff97dee00708: Do I need Apex or a developer to set up MultiDatePick?
1e49f24e83b2: No. You install the package, build a config in the Setup Wizard by picking objects and fields from dropdowns, and drop the component on a page or a Flow screen. No Apex required.
4441c79a3a0a: Which MultiDatePick permission set should I assign?
0906b457e6ef: MultiDatePick - Setup for the admins who build configs, MultiDatePick - User for everyone who only uses the calendars, and MultiDatePick - All Access for admins who do both. Users also need access to your own objects and fields.
0a497bf3663b: Why is there no Save button on my App Page or Home Page calendar?
88fd9f00478b: App, Home and Experience pages have no record of their own. Set Static Parent Record Id to the record the dates belong to and the Save button appears.
86b94154a973: Do I have to set every checkbox in Flow Builder?
2b7aa14b0ce7: No. Set Config Name to the config you saved in the Setup Wizard and every checkbox setting comes from the config. Only if you skip Config Name and set properties by hand do you set the checkboxes yourself.
0e8f2bf494e4: Can I move a MultiDatePick config to another Salesforce org?
84739e4036f7: Yes. Export it from the Existing Configurations tab, then paste the JSON into the Import tab in the other org. Smart Field Mapping lets you match any object or field names that differ.
